req.title: Register form html served
req.statement: The system shall include HTML input fields named 'username' and 'password' in the /auth/register page.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-027 requires that GET /auth/register returns an HTTP 2xx response containing HTML input fields named 'username' and 'password'. Three tests are designed: (1) a positive EP test verifying the exact status code 200 and presence of both named input fields in the response body; (2) a negative NEG test verifying that a wrong HTTP method (POST with no data) does NOT produce the register form as a 200 with empty fields — instead it re-renders with a flash error, confirming the GET path is distinct; (3) a BVA boundary test verifying the exact byte-level HTML attribute strings 'name="username"' and 'name="password"' appear exactly in the response, catching mutations that alter field names or remove them. Each test is self-contained, uses in-process Flask test client, and asserts exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_register_get_returns_200_with_username_and_password_fields():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/auth/register')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'name="username"' in r.data
    assert b'name="password"' in r.data
    os.unlink(path)

test_register_get_returns_200_with_username_and_password_fields()

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_register_get_does_not_return_4xx_or_5xx():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/auth/register')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.status_code != 400
    assert r.status_code != 404
    assert r.status_code != 500
    assert len(r.data) > 0
    assert b'Internal Server Error' not in r.data
    os.unlink(path)

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_register_get_html_contains_exact_input_name_attributes():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.app_context():
        from flaskr.db import init_db
        init_db()
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/auth/register')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'name="username"' in r.data
    assert b'name="password"' in r.data
    assert b'name="user_name"' not in r.data
    assert b'name="passwd"' not in r.data
    assert b'name="user"' not in r.data
    assert b'name="pass"' not in r.data
    os.unlink(path)
